0022600007.text: The Nuggets open their 2026-27 season on the road against the Oklahoma City Thunder, who are 1-0 and sit 2nd in the Northwest and 6th in the West. Denver lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3 to Oklahoma City, but it won the most recent meeting 127-107 in Denver on April 10, 2026. Denver is without Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while Oklahoma City is without Nikola Topic (back surgery), Otega Oweh (Achilles surgery), and Thomas Sorber (knee surgery).
